run_image_classification: run the image classification fine-tuning script with a pretrained model and dataset from the HuggingFace hub
create_model_load_pretrained: create a pretrained image classification model from a HuggingFace model identifier or local path
build_dataset_load_imagefolder: build a dataset from a local image folder with train and validation directories
test_evaluate_model: test and evaluate the fine-tuned image classification model on a validation dataset
summarize_training_args: summarize the training arguments and configuration for the image classification Trainer
